about.label: About us
about.title: General information about the school
about.text: The Presidential School in Jizzakh was established on the initiative of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev. This institution is a model school opened in our country to identify gifted children and provide them with education in accordance with world standards based on advanced technologies. The school operates in a boarding school system. In it, students live and study on the territory itself, provided with a full dormitory, free food and special clothing, 5 days a week.

about_page.title: About school
about_page.info_text: The Presidential School in Jizzakh was established on the initiative of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan Shavkat Mirziyoyev. This institution is a model school opened in our country to identify gifted children and provide them with education in accordance with world standards based on advanced technologies. The school operates in a boarding school system.
about_page.vision_text: The vision of the Presidential Schools is to prepare the next generation of leaders to actively and positively contribute to the development of Uzbekistan by providing educational opportunities that encourage the nation's gifted and talented youth to realize their potential as creative, innovative participants in a dynamic global society.
about_page.mission_text: The mission of the Presidential Schools (PS) is to enhance the educational experience for gifted students through a programme of academic excellence and holistic learning opportunities to develop the leadership potential of its graduates to contribute to the future of Uzbekistan.
about_page.profile_title: Profile of a Presidential School graduate
about_page.profile_intro: The profile of a Presidential School graduate identifies the attributes of a student able to successfully meet the challenges of the programme's vision and mission.
about_page.profile_ethical_text: I demonstrate my civic responsibility to the Republic of Uzbekistan and to the global community through my positive contributions to society and my ethical decision-making.
about_page.profile_critical_text: I use reliable and relevant evidence to develop understanding across a broad range of disciplines to design and implement solutions to complex problems.
about_page.profile_responsible_text: I take responsibility for my own actions and the consequences that accompany them, and view risk as an opportunity to learn.
about_page.profile_academic_text: I demonstrate mastery of academic skills and diligently pursue self-improvement in my understanding through achievements in coursework, competitions and research.
about_page.profile_leader_text: I lead others by setting direction and creating a shared vision, by showing empathy and the willingness to consider different perspectives.
about_page.profile_global_text: I understand and appreciate my own culture and the perspectives of others in the global community.
about_page.profile_collaborator_text: I understand and express ideas and information confidently and creatively in collaboration with others.
about_page.profile_balanced_text: I develop myself in mind, body and spirit to achieve personal well-being.
about_page.cert_title: We are an internationally certified and eco-school!

education_page.title: Education
education_page.criteria_text: The Presidential School offers a high-quality academic program combining national curriculum with CAIE international program.
education_page.stages_extra: Education at the school is conducted in three languages — Uzbek, Russian and English. IGCSE program, AS and A Level programs, IELTS and SAT exams.
education_page.extra_sub: It ensures the physical, spiritual and mental balance of students.
education_page.grad_text: Year 10 students sit AS Level exams, Year 11 sit A Level exams. Graduates receive NCSE and CAIE AS/A Level diplomas.

application_page.process_text: The school's three-stage admissions process is highly selective. Approximately 3,500 applicants compete for just 24 available spots in 5th grade. The acceptance rate is approximately 0.7%. Cambridge Assessment International Education provides the examination materials.
application_page.req_who_text: Graduates of the 4th grade are admitted to the 5th grade. Annual grades in STEAM subjects (Mathematics, Sciences) must be "5" (Excellent).
application_page.req_region_text: A student can only apply to the Presidential School located in the region where they are currently studying.
application_page.req_online_text: Documents accepted from May 25 to June 14 via ariza.piima.uz or my.gov.uz. A 3x4 photo and copy of the report card are required.
application_page.stage1_text: Mathematics Test. 30 tasks (multiple-choice). Categories: A (easy), B (medium), C (difficult). 90 minutes.
application_page.stage2_text: Exam Structure: Critical Thinking (16 problems), English Language (40 multiple-choice questions), Logical Mathematics (24 problems). Total Time: 150 minutes.
application_page.result_timeline_text: Stage 1 within 20 days. Stage 2 within 30 days. Note: Results cannot be reconsidered.
application_page.result_reserve_text: Top 48 students who don't pass Stage 2 will be accepted into their chosen specialized school without an entrance exam.
application_page.result_contact_text: For additional information: Call Center: 1206 · Website: piima.uz · Phone: +998 71 207-99-98

admission_rules.section1_desc: The school's three-stage admission process is highly selective, featuring two mandatory ability tests assessing critical thinking, problem-solving skills, and English proficiency. Each year, an average of 3,500 candidates compete for just 24 spots in the 5th grade. The admission rate is approximately 0.7%. To guarantee transparency and objectivity, Cambridge Assessment International Education provides the examination materials and fully monitors the entire entrance exam process.
